name: mond-compat
subtitle: Experimental iPadOS Mode write verification on iOS 27.0.1
description: Unsigned mond fork with validated experimental iPadOS Mode nibble locator, on-disk write-readback checks, original MobileGestalt .plist export and diagnostic Share/Copy/Files export. Apple iPadOS UI activation is unverified; a boot loop is possible.

apps.name: mond-compat
apps.subtitle: iPadOS Mode verification tools for iOS 27.0.1
apps.localizedDescription: Compares Nugget-style device class nibble and capability flags, verifies on-disk writes, provides non-mutating O_RDWR diagnostic and original MobileGestalt export. No claim of successful system-level iPadOS activation; using experimental mode can cause a boot loop.

versions.localizedDescription: iPadOS class and flags on-disk verification, original backup export.
versions.changelog: Validate original DeviceClassNumber=1 and experimental patch location. Require DeviceClassNumber=3 plus all five flags to show enabled. Report open-for-write result without writing. Verify full file read-back after applying/reverting; export original .plist to Files; avoid automatic respring for experimental iPadOS. Real-device activation is not yet verified.
